name: University of South China
supervisors: Hunan Provincial Government (co-built with MIIT, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, the National Health Commission, SASTIND and CNNC)

evidence.summary: The University of South China describes itself as co-built by the Hunan government with MIIT, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, the National Health Commission, SASTIND and the state nuclear group CNNC.

It reports national defence basic research projects among its more than 3,900 research projects, a national defence science and technology innovation team, and defence key and shortage majors, and says its graduates work in the defence and nuclear industries.
